Name: Kunkun Weapon Stats Patcher
Author: Dingtrue114
Description:
Description
Weapon Stats Patcher is an in-game UI utility that allows you to dynamically search and edit the stats of all weapons. You can tweak weapon balance or customize weapons right inside the game.
Please note that my programming skills are limited, and a significant portion of this mod was generated with the help of AI. As a result, the mod might still feel a bit rough around the edges. I truly appreciate your understanding and patience!
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu (Highly Recommended).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game![/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]In-Game Editor UI: Open the menu via a hotkey to seamlessly search weapons by Display Name, Internal Name, or Item ID.[/*]
[*]Low-Level Patching: Powered by Harmony, changes instantly apply to weapons in your inventory, chests, and even shop stock lists.[/*]
[*]Comprehensive Stat Editing: Edit Min/Max Damage, Speed, Knockback, Crit Chance, Crit Multiplier, and toggle whether the weapon can be lost on death.[/*]
[*]Custom Enchantments: Easily toggle powerful enchantments (Crusader, Vampiric, Artful, Bug Killer, etc.) via checkboxes.[/*]
[*]Flexible GMCM Customization: Fully compatible with Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to customize hotkeys, UI panels, spacing, text scaling, and offsets.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API (Required)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (Highly Recommended)[/*]
[/list]A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4404]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4404[/url]
模组简介
坤坤武器属性编辑器是一款功能强大的游戏内武器属性动态编辑器，允许玩家在游戏内实时搜索并修改所有武器的基础属性和附魔。
另外想提前说明的是，由于本人的编程水平非常有限，代码中的很多内容都是借助 AI 协助生成的，所以模组目前可能显得比较粗糙，难免会有不完美的地方，希望大家能够理解！
[b]安装说明[/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装最新版本的 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]安装 Generic Mod Config Menu (通用模组配置菜单，强烈推荐)。[/*]
[*]下载本模组，并将其解压到你的 Stardew Valley/Mods 文件夹中。[/*]
[*]启动游戏即可！[/*]
[/list][b]核心特色[/b]
[list]
[*]游戏内直观 UI：按下快捷键即可打开菜单，支持通过武器中文名、英文名或内部 ID 进行快速搜索。[/*]
[*]底层拦截刷新：采用 Harmony 技术，修改后的属性完美覆盖背包、箱子中的武器，甚至能直接作用于商店列表。[/*]
[*]全方位属性修改：支持修改最低/最高伤害、攻击速度、击退距离、暴击概率、暴击倍率以及死亡时是否会掉落。[/*]
[*]自由附魔配置：一键为武器勾选各种强力附魔（如十字军、吸血、艺术、杀虫等），支持多重附魔并存。[/*]
[*]界面高度自订：完全兼容通用模组配置菜单（GMCM），可在游戏内随时修改快捷键以及自定义详细的 UI 界面布局与偏移量。[/*]
[/list][b]前置需求[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API (必备前置)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (强烈推荐前置)[/*]
[/list]我的星露谷物语全部模组清单可在此链接查看：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4404]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4404[/url]
